post.summary: Registers a user in a tenant.
Signs a user in and returns an access and refresh token pair.
post.description: Unknown accounts, wrong passwords and unknown tenants all return the same message and take the same time, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover which addresses are registered.

post.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair.
post.description: Rotating: the presented token is revoked and a successor is issued in the same family. Presenting an already-revoked token revokes the whole family, because that is what a replayed stolen token looks like.

post.summary: Revokes a refresh token, or every session the user holds.
Changes the signed-in user's password and ends every session.

get.summary: Public keys for verifying AdNoir access tokens.
Lists organisation units within the caller's scope.

put.summary: Renames a unit, and re-slugs it when a new slug is supplied.
put.description: Changing the slug rewrites the hierarchy path of the entire subtree, so it is requested explicitly rather than derived from the new name.

delete.summary: Deletes a unit that has no children.

get.summary: Lists the direct children of a unit.
Lists a unit and everything beneath it.

post.summary: Moves a unit under a different parent.
post.description: Rejected when the target parent sits inside the unit's own subtree.

get.summary: Lists users within the caller's scope.

post.summary: Creates a user in the current tenant.

put.description: Rotates the user's security stamp, so tokens issued before the change are reissued with new claims at the next refresh.

post.summary: Deactivates a user and revokes every session they hold.
Replaces a user's forgotten password with a temporary one.
post.description: Revokes every session the user holds, clears any lockout and forces a password change at the next sign-in.

get.summary: Lists the roles available to the current tenant, including system roles.

put.summary: Updates a role's name and permissions.
put.description: Bumps the tenant's permission-matrix version, which invalidates every service's cached copy without an eviction message.

delete.summary: Deletes a tenant role that nobody holds.
